subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 13 grouped action upgrades in secret-bearing, security, and release workflows after the latest head stabilizes?
rationale: CI cannot establish whether maintainers accept the combined supply-chain and rollback scope, and CODEOWNERS explicitly reserves several touched workflows for secops review.

options.title: Approve Stable Head
options.body: Have secops and a release/CI owner review the final exact pins and merge once the rebased head completes required checks.

options.title: Split Sensitive Families
options.body: Separate Codex, token, CodeQL, and release-publishing action upgrades if owners want narrower validation and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Regenerate Later
options.body: Close and let Dependabot recreate the bundle if repository-access failures or continuous rebases prevent a stable reviewable head.

recommendation.title: Approve Stable Head
recommendation.body: Have secops and a release/CI owner review the final exact pins and merge once the rebased head completes required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-workflow history and the explicit timeline mention make this the strongest individual routing candidate, alongside the required secops team review.
